overview: The committee approved the April City Council newsletter and reviewed plans for a series of neighborhood ward meetings scheduled to begin in September. Discussions focused on budget transparency and securing accessible, hybrid-capable venues for resident outreach.

items.title: City Council Newsletter Approval
items.summary: Approved the April edition of the City Council newsletter, which summarizes recent meetings, school repair requests, and departmental budget requests. The committee discussed adding direct links to budget charts to help residents track fiscal year comparisons.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings Planning
items.summary: The committee discussed a preliminary schedule for ward meetings to run from September through May, emphasizing the need for hybrid technology and local venues like fire stations and schools. Councilors volunteered to co-host specific wards, and the item was kept in committee to finalize locations and dates.
